subject: session: add a session variable to control whether to use hash join v2 in TiFlash (#60300)
summary: Introduces new global/session sysvar `tiflash_hash_join_version` (legacy/optimized, default optimized) and wires it through SessionVars and DistSQLContext so TiFlash requests can be annotated to enable/disable hash join v2. Planner-side fine-grained shuffle handling is adjusted to avoid applying join-build fine-grained shuffle when the join is eligible for TiFlash hash join v2 (based on join shape and TiFlash spill-related session settings).
